title: Fragments of the Hellenistic Jewish historians (Demetrius, Eupolemus, Pseudo-Eupolemus, Artapanus, Cleodemus, Aristeas, Theodotus, Philo the Epic poet) plus Aristobulus; RU «Иудейско-эллинистические историки»
author: Various, mostly via Alexander Polyhistor in Eusebius, Praeparatio Evangelica IX and Clement
size: est. 12–15k words in total; Artapanus about 2.5k
edition: Gifford, Praeparatio Evangelica, 1903, public domain: https://archive.org/details/evangelicaepraep02euse. Freudenthal 1875, public domain. Mras GCS 1954–56 and Holladay (copyrighted).
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka (Артапан, Эвполем, Александр Полигистор) returns studies only. Only Ezekiel's Exagoge is translated (Религия. Церковь. Общество, 2019). No Russian Praeparatio Evangelica found.
en_evidence: C. R. Holladay, Fragments from Hellenistic Jewish Authors I–IV (SBL 1983–96; Aristobulus in vol. III, 1995), per Open Library.
other_translations: German: N. Walter, JSHRZ (1970s–80s), not verified in this sweep.
value: The earliest Jewish historiography in Greek: Moses as culture-hero (Artapanus), the Solomon–Hiram letters (Eupolemus), biblical chronography. Key for Jewish-Greek identity, Hellenistic legend and romance (parallels to Sesonchosis and Nectanebo), and New Testament backgrounds.
ai_feasibility: High. Short Koine excerpts, much of it reported speech. Risks: variants in Eusebius' manuscripts and chronological arithmetic. Holladay for cross-checking.
pilot_unit: Artapanus frs. 1–3 plus Demetrius frs. 1–6 (PE IX 18, 21, 23, 27, 29), about 5k words.
